name: Meeting - Book Meeting Room

parameters.query: SELECT id FROM {{TENANT_SCHEMA}}.meeting_rooms WHERE id = $1 AND is_active = true AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM {{TENANT_SCHEMA}}.meeting_bookings b WHERE b.room_id = $1 AND b.status != 'CANCELLED' AND tsrange(b.start_time, b.end_time) && tsrange($2::timestamp, $3::timestamp));
INSERT INTO {{TENANT_SCHEMA}}.meeting_bookings (room_id, organizer_id, title, start_time, end_time, status, description) VALUES ($1,$2,$3,$4,$5,'SCHEDULED',$6) RETURNING id;

options.queryReplacement: ={{$('Webhook - Book Meeting').item.json.body.room_id}},={{$('Webhook - Book Meeting').item.json.body.organizer_id}},={{$('Webhook - Book Meeting').item.json.body.title}},={{$('Webhook - Book Meeting').item.json.body.start_time}},={{$('Webhook - Book Meeting').item.json.body.end_time}},={{$('Webhook - Book Meeting').item.json.body.agenda || $('Webhook - Book Meeting').item.json.body.description}}

parameters.query: SELECT name, capacity FROM {{TENANT_SCHEMA}}.meeting_rooms WHERE id = $1;

parameters.responseBody: ={"success": false, "error": "Phòng họp không khả dụng trong khung giờ này."}
